findings.message: No exact current outside mapping was established for ETH-2200 or BUS-2100. FIN-3010 has conflicting Study.com credit claims and remains unresolved. The featured SOC-2100 and FIL-1100 Human Cultures choices remain research gaps; other approved category choices may fit. MAN-3720 and MAN-3310 now have provider-published conditional candidates, not individual TESU approvals.

Scientific Knowledge category replacements BIO-1010 and NUT-1010 need written current-catalog allocation approval; the community roadmap alone does not certify their placement in this individual degree.
Prerequisites, future course offerings, official evaluation and personal catalog eligibility remain to be confirmed.
